source_gap_claims.behavior: Network-capability declarations must specify allowed schemes and targets, ownership for redirects, DNS resolution, private/loopback/metadata blocking, controlled internal exceptions, and timeout; validation must reject arbitrary URL execution, HTTP downgrade, or missing redirect/address policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require these network declaration fields or their specific rejection rules.
source_gap_claims.subject: Network capability declaration validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Package A validation must not perform DNS resolution or URL requests, and must treat network tooling as outside its implementation scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations exclude some infrastructure and package installation but do not prohibit validator DNS/request activity.
source_gap_claims.subject: Network execution boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Inventory mode must report a pre-standard fixture as legacy while strict mode rejects it; a migrated fixture must validate with owner-specific authority and lifecycle fields preserved, and an absent quality sidecar must not silently pass. The migration oracle must compare before/after owner and authorizes fields for drift.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation defines inventory-versus-strict behavior, migrated-fixture preservation, absent-sidecar handling, or the migration oracle comparison.
source_gap_claims.subject: Legacy and migrated fixture behavior

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must never rewrite the inspected package during inventory, strict validation, or migration checks.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not impose a no-rewrite invariant on inspected packages.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator package immutability

source_gap_claims.behavior: Terminal acceptance must reject inconsistent policy/schema versions, an unused policy, or a dangling standard link, and must keep the reference package as a fixture rather than an installed Skill or new workflow entry.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing obligations cover use of published policy/schemas and reference-package validation, but not these version-consistency, link-integrity, fixture-placement, or non-installation/workflow boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: Reference-package terminal acceptance

source_gap_claims.behavior: One repository-owned pytest terminal selection must execute all Package A unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration cases with independent expected results and explicit case/assertion mappings.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations require module and parameter coverage but do not require this single repository-owned all-case terminal selection and its complete category coverage.
source_gap_claims.subject: Package A terminal test selection

source_gap_claims.behavior: Terminal acceptance must fail when a required case is missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or affected by a harness error; an expected rejection of a negative fixture must count as a passing test.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation defines these required-case status rules or the distinction between expected negative rejection and overall suite failure.
source_gap_claims.subject: Required-case terminal outcome rules
